name: Correlation Matrix
when_to_pick: Show the pairwise correlations between 3-10 instruments (FX pairs, crypto, indices, metals) as a heatmap. Use it to expose hidden over-exposure — e.g. long EUR/USD + long GBP/USD at +0.86 is really one EUR-weighted bet, not diversification. Cells use a theme-aware diverging scale: green for positive (aligned) correlation, red for negative (inverse), faint neutral near zero, with an axis legend. Pass a square matrix whose rows/cols match the symbols order; the diagonal is always 1.

caption.description: One or two sentences that deliver the takeaway — name the specific pairs and their correlation, and the risk they imply (over-exposure / hidden concentration).

symbols.description: Instrument labels in the same order as the matrix rows AND columns. Keep them short (e.g. 'EUR/USD', 'XAU/USD', 'BTC/USD').

matrix.description: Square correlation matrix, one inner array per symbol (row order = symbols order). Values in [-1, 1]; the diagonal should be 1 and the matrix symmetric.
